  context={"endpoint"}
>

Sets the admin-allow, realm-allow, and realm-block IP rule lists for this cluster. Each category you include entirely replaces the existing rules in that category (rules not in the new list are removed; new addresses are added). Omit a category to leave it unchanged. The total number of rules is limited by the cluster's tier.
